mapper.select: SELECT h.symbol, s.name, h.quantity, h.avg_price AS avgPrice, h.avg_fx_rate AS avgFxRate, h.total_fee AS totalFee, h.realized_pnl_krw AS realizedPnlKrw, p.close AS currentPrice, ROUND(h.quantity * p.close * #{fxRate}, 2) AS marketValueKrw, ROUND(h.quantity * (p.close * #{fxRate} - h.avg_price * h.avg_fx_rate), 2) AS evalPnlKrw FROM holdings h JOIN stocks s ON s.symbol = h.symbol LEFT JOIN daily_prices p ON p.symbol = h.symbol AND p.trade_date = (SELECT MAX(trade_date) FROM daily_prices WHERE symbol = h.symbol) WHERE h.user_id = #{userId} AND h.quantity > 0 ORDER BY h.symbol
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO holdings (user_id, portfolio_id, symbol, quantity, avg_price, avg_fx_rate, total_fee, realized_pnl_krw, recalculated_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{portfolioId}, #{symbol}, #{quantity}, #{avgPrice}, #{avgFxRate}, #{totalFee}, #{realizedPnlKrw}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE quantity = VALUES(quantity), avg_price = VALUES(avg_price), avg_fx_rate = VALUES(avg_fx_rate), total_fee = VALUES(total_fee), realized_pnl_krw = VALUES(realized_pnl_krw), recalculated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)
mapper.select: SELECT ROUND(SUM(h.quantity * p.close * #{fxRate}), 2) FROM holdings h LEFT JOIN daily_prices p ON p.symbol = h.symbol AND p.trade_date = (SELECT MAX(trade_date) FROM daily_prices WHERE symbol = h.symbol) WHERE h.user_id = #{userId} AND h.quantity > 0

SELECT h.symbol, h.quantity, h.avg_price AS avgPrice, h.avg_fx_rate AS avgFxRate, p.close AS currentPrice FROM holdings h LEFT JOIN daily_prices p ON p.symbol = h.symbol AND p.trade_date = (SELECT MAX(trade_date) FROM daily_prices WHERE symbol = h.symbol) WHERE h.user_id = #{userId} AND h.quantity > 0 AND h.symbol = #{symbol} ORDER BY h.symbol

SELECT h.symbol, h.quantity, h.avg_price AS avgPrice, h.avg_fx_rate AS avgFxRate, p.close AS currentPrice FROM holdings h LEFT JOIN daily_prices p ON p.symbol = h.symbol AND p.trade_date = (SELECT MAX(trade_date) FROM daily_prices WHERE symbol = h.symbol AND trade_date <= #{asOf}) WHERE h.user_id = #{userId} AND h.quantity > 0 AND h.symbol = #{symbol} ORDER BY h.symbol
